description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework project. It declares abstract classes for warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms, including methods for serialization, category management, and event reporting.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events with methods for serialization, deserialization, category retrieval, string conversion, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Represents a warning reporting unit capable of reporting events, fetching category info, and managing category controls.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with an identifier and associated event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a warning category, including default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configurations.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the reporting unit's category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the reporting unit's category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Marks a category to be excluded from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a category with provided settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the category control.
